postconditions.description: The dimensions of the level maps are between 1 and 10.
The number of levels and the constant w are between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.expression: Each level is described by n lines, each line contains m characters
postconditions.description: The input format for each level is as described.

postconditions.expression: The first line of the output is the minimum number of transferred bytes
postconditions.description: The output must include the total number of bytes transferred.

postconditions.expression: The next k lines describe the way to transfer each level
postconditions.description: Each level is described by a pair of integers indicating the method of transfer.

postconditions.expression: If y_i equals 0, the level is transferred in full
postconditions.description: If the second number in the pair is 0, the level is transferred without any difference.

postconditions.expression: Otherwise, y_i must be equal to the number of a previously transferred level
postconditions.description: If the second number is not 0, it must be the index of a previously transferred level whose difference is used to transfer the current level.

postconditions.expression: The levels are numbered 1 through k in the order they follow in the input
postconditions.description: The levels are indexed from 1 to k as they appear in the input.
